entities.summary: Nicolas Hague is a Canadian ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Nashville Predators of the National Hockey League (NHL). Hague was selected 34th overall by the Vegas Golden Knights in the 2017 NHL Entry Draft, with whom he won the Stanley Cup in 2023.
